doc.title: Three Words
doc.notes_md:
### Key Links

- According to Eliane's Bardic Book: "Written for Her Stellar Highness Elashava's Bardic Challenge, on the occasion of Northshield Coronet Tourney and Investiture in Korsvag, May 4, AS XXXVII. Chorus tune: Anon. Sephardic song, 'Porque Llorax'. Remainder of tune and lyrics Š4/7/02 Eliane Halevy (Legal Name 021)"
